note: lean = toolchain/lean_infer.py one2one-only + BN-fuse path (per gpu-baseline-must-be-optimized rule; naive rows are strawman, listed for reference only)

gpu.power_system_source: wall/current-meter measurement of the whole PC under GPU inference load (user-measured 2026-09-01); this is the number for the comparison table -- a GPU cannot run without the host PC
gpu.power_gpu_board_only_source: nvidia-smi power.draw polled at 2Hz during sustained load; board-only, NOT comparable to standalone-device power

cpu.power_note: system wall power under CPU-only load not yet measured (use the same current-meter method as the GPU row; TDP is not a fair substitute once system power is the basis)

power_basis: whole-device wall power for every row: PC total for CPU/GPU (a discrete GPU cannot run without the host), board total for the FPGA (standalone device, 6.71 W current-meter)
equivalence: lean vs unfused ref max |d| = 1.236e-03 (known BN-folding rounding, documented bound 2.1e-3)
